title: Ithobalus (Ethbaal)
summary: Priest of Astarte who killed Pheles and ruled Tyre, in Menander (Cory 1876). The edition's footnote treats him as distinct from the later Ithobalus of the siege.
description: Added from the Cory import. Display only. Cory gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not a BC year this record can sort on, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Cory is display-only and gives none).

reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 30; Menander of Ephesus, ap. Josephus
reign.note: Ithobalus [Ethbaal], priest of Astarte. The edition's footnote on p. 32 treats this king as distinct from the Ithobalus of Nebuchadnezzar's siege.
